column1: # Outcomes of an unreadable row platform/doors/<сервер> (ADR-0088 addendum (1) R7, addendum (2) S11). A row: path<TAB>reader<TAB>outcome<TAB>priority<TAB>unit<TAB>norm.
# path — the refusal path (JSON Pointer; "" — the whole row); priority — smaller is earlier; unit — the unit of unreadability.

column3: the whole row is unreadable: the server is not a candidate for an order; the fields of the unreadable row are not replaced by absence, the cause goes to the log (layout audit, G-09; rule DF-OUTCOMES-109, the Architect's decision of 2026-10-25)

the whole row is unreadable: the life of the resource is judged by a change of the row version (resource_state of the observation contract), not by its fields; the fields of the unreadable row are not replaced by absence; the door row of a decommissioned server is unreadable — the console pass deletes it all the same: delete with cas by the version read, the content is not needed for the deletion (V7 item 3, row 12); the cause goes to the log (layout audit, G-09; rule DF-OUTCOMES-109, the Architect's decision of 2026-10-25)

the whole row is unreadable: restore — the door is unreadable, the restoration is incomplete; mirror — there is no address, the server is not a neighbour of this pass; the fields of the unreadable row are not replaced by absence, the cause goes to the log (layout audit, G-09; rule DF-OUTCOMES-109, the Architect's decision of 2026-10-25)

the door row of its own server is unreadable: the object client with a bare cluster:// — reading the cluster objects is «unknown», not «no», not a start refusal and not a refusal of writing to its own catalogue; on the next access the row is read anew (P3; V7 item 3, row 11)
